en-US.description: Remote control client computers on your local network. Let network users login with username and password. Set login credentials on server side.
en-US.longDescription:
Remote control client computers on your local network. Let network users login with username and password. Set login credentials on server side. Vovsoft Network Authenticator must be installed in server computer and client computers. You can allow users login to your server without Active Directory requirement.

First, the software must be installed selecting "Server Mode" on a computer that is assigned as server. You will be able to display all client computers on server side. You can lock or unlock any client computer. You can also send text messages to any client computer or close the client software on server side. Client credentials must be kept in "Usernames and Passwords" tab.

All client computers must install the software selecting "Client Mode". Server IP address must be correctly entered. If a client computer can successfully connect to the server computer, the software will lock the client computer. Server administrator can unlock the client computer (on server side) or a valid username and password must be entered in order to unlock the client computer (on client side).
en-US.name: Vovsoft Network Authenticator
